# con ggmap

mapa <- get_map(location = c(lon = -85.55, lat = 11),  zoom = 10)
ggmap(mapa)

mam.spdf <- SpatialPointsDataFrame(coords = mam[, 2:3], proj4string = CRS("+proj=tmerc +lat_0=0 +lon_0=-84 +k=0.9999 +x_0=500000 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +towgs84=0,0,0,0,0,0,0 +units=m +no_defs"), data = mam) 
mam.spdf
mam.cg <- spTransform(mam.spdf, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84"))
mam.cg

mam.cg.df <- as.data.frame(mam.cg)
mam.cg.df

ggmap(mapa) + geom_point(data = mam.cg.df, aes(x=X.coord.1, y=Y.coord.1), colour= "red")

ggmap(mapa, extent = "device") + stat_density2d(aes(x = X.coord.1, y = Y.coord.1, fill = ..level..,alpha = ..level..), size = 2, bins = 4, data = mam.cg.df, geom = "polygon") +
  scale_fill_gradient("Density") +
  scale_alpha(range = c(.4, .75), guide = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 1.5, barheight = 10))
